exercises.name: Form abstract words from these personal nouns

questions.prompt: the destitution of the old woman
This tribe does not fear hunger because they know how to hoe.
questions.answer: Ubu bwoko ntibutinya ubushonji kuko buzi guhinga

questions.prompt: His good chieftainship takes people out of their rebelliousness
questions.answer: Ubutware bwe bwiza bukura abantu mu bugome bwabo

questions.prompt: You must find a long boat because all of these people must be able to sit in it.
questions.answer: Ukwiriye kubona ubwato burebure, kuko aba bose bakwiriye kubona uko/uburyo babwicaramo

questions.prompt: Don't you know how to cook corn? Let me help you, because it's getting dark.
questions.answer: Ntuzi uburyo bwo guteka ibigori? Reka ngufashe, kuko burije

questions.prompt: There are many tribes in this country, yet they all live together in peace.
questions.answer: Hari/hariho amoko menshi muri iki gihugu, nyamara bose babana amahoro

questions.prompt: Abatware ntibakunda kubona ubunebwe mu bakozi babo.
questions.answer: Chiefs don't like to find laziness amongst their workers.

questions.prompt: Kubona uburyarya mu bantu be bizakomeza kumutera agahinda.
questions.answer: To find hypocrisy among his people will continue to bring sorrow to him

questions.prompt: Uriya muhungu azagura uburabyo bwiza bwo kujyana mu bukwe.
questions.answer: That boy will buy pretty flowers to take to the wedding

questions.prompt: Abantu bo muri iki gihugu bakwiriye kugira igihe cyo gufasha abakene mu butindi bwabo.
questions.answer: The people in this country should take time to help the poor in their poverty/need

questions.prompt: Bavuga yuko bariya bantu ar'ubwoko bubi, ariko simbona impamvu yo kubavuga nabi.
questions.answer: They say that those people are (of) a bad tribe, but I don't see any reason to speak badly about them.

questions.prompt: Guhora mu byaha n'ubupfu kuko bitazana umunezero n'amahoro.
questions.answer: To continue in sin is foolishness because it doesn't bring happiness and peace

questions.prompt: Mbese, ntufite uburyo bwo kuzazana ibijumba ubundi? None simfite agafranga na kamwe ko kubigura.
questions.answer: Don't you have a way to bring sweet potatoes some other time? Today I don't have any money whatsoever to buy them.

questions.prompt: Inka zikunda ubwatsi bubisi kandi burebure.
questions.answer: Cows love fresh and long grass.

questions.prompt: N'unyereka uburyo bwo kubikora ndabikora muri iki gitondo.
questions.answer: If you show me how to do it, I will do it this morning.
